answer: AI agents establish Sybil resistance via cryptographic attestation to a unique hardware secure enclave. Each enclave, containing unforgeable identifiers like embedded copper traces, a unique crystal oscillator, and a factory-provisioned immutable relic ID, generates a unique identity proof. An attacker must physically acquire or fabricate an equivalent number of these specialized, scarce hardware units per fake agent, facing insurmountable manufacturing and supply chain costs for each distinct identity.
